drivers: Wednesday's AI rally is reversing: Nasdaq-100 futures are down 1.6% and S&P 500 futures 0.9% after Meta and Tesla results failed to ease worries about AI spending and returns. Meta slipped about 2% after announcing new non-voting Class C shares and a 2027 split alongside a big legal charge, and Tesla fell about 3.5% after cutting its 2026 capex plan to about $20B. Chip stocks lead the decline, with Lam Research down 9% after results and SOXX down about 4% pre-market. Oil is adding pressure: Brent is near $112, close to a five-month high, after more Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia; Asia fell hard (Nikkei −2.7%, Hang Seng −3.0%) and Europe is lower. Treasuries are bid (10Y ~5.04%), the VIX is near 18, gold is down 1.4% and Bitcoin is down about 2%. The Fed is in its quiet period ahead of the Oct 27–28 FOMC.
